description: A Java class 'List5' extending ListActivity, demonstrating a list view with separators and custom adapter implementation.

classes.name: List5
classes.description: Main activity class displaying a list with separators.

classes.name: MyListAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter class for populating list items with separator logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the custom list adapter.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the list.

methods.name: areAllItemsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether all list items are enabled.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Determines if a specific item is enabled based on its content.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns the item at a specific position (here, the position itself).

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the ID for the item at a specific position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a TextView for a list item and sets its text.
